item.title: Navigation & Map System Design
item.description:
Navigation & Map System Design

← Back to Index | Next: Controls & Combat →

🧭 System Overview

The Navigation & Map System is the player’s primary tool for situational awareness in the Extraction zone. Unlike traditional shooters where red dots reveal enemies, Extraction Shooters rely on Intel-based Navigation. The system prioritizes sound, line-of-sight, and tactical markings over “god-mode” radar.

Key Design Pillars:

  1. Intel over Omniscience: The map shows known info, not all info.
  2. Communication Focus: Pings and Markers replace voice chat for rapid tactical coordination.
  3. Diegetic Integration: UI elements should feel like tactical augmented reality (AR) gear.
  4. Audio-Visual Synergy: Visualizing sound (footsteps/gunfire) for mobile accessibility.

🧭 HUD Compass Ring

Instead of a First-Person Shooter (FPS) style horizontal “Compass Tape”, the compass is integrated directly into the Minimap border.

Design & Behavior

The compass is a Ring surrounding the square/circular Minimap at the top-right corner.

  • Visual Style: A calibrated ring with Cardinal Directions (N, E, S, W) and degree ticks.
  • Rotation Logic: Depends on Minimap settings (see below).
    • If Map Rotates (Player-Up): The Compass Ring rotates so “North” always points to the true North of the map.
    • If Map Static (North-Up): The Compass Ring is fixed with “North” at the top. The player arrow inside rotates.
  • Indicators on Ring:
    • Red Arcs: Incoming fire direction (Audio/Hit).
    • Blue Chevrons: Off-screen teammates.
    • Gold Arrow: Main Objective / Extraction direction.

🗺️ Minimap (HUD Radar)

Core Mechanics

The Minimap is a constant HUD element located at the Top-Right (default).

  • Shape: Option for Circle (Default) or Square (Settings).
  • Orientation Settings:
    1. Option A: Player-Up (Default)
      • Behavior: The Map rotates. The Player Arrow is fixed pointing UP.
      • Compass: The border ring rotates to show direction.
      • Best for: Tactical navigation and immediate combat awareness.
    2. Option B: North-Up (Static)
      • Behavior: The Map is fixed (North is Up). The Player Arrow rotates.
      • Compass: The border ring is static.
      • Best for: Coordinate communication and map reading experts.

Visual Indicators

Indicator Icon Color Behavior
Player Arrow 🟡 Yellow Fixed Up (Player-Up) or Rotates (North-Up).
Teammate Circle + Number 🔵 Blue Shows directional arrow if off-map on the Compass Ring.
Enemy (Visual) Solid Dot 🔴 Red Only appears if scanned by UAV/Ability or team LOS (Line of Sight).
Enemy (Audio) Pulsing Wave 🔴 Red / ⚪ White Shows direction of sound (footsteps/shots). See Sound Visualization.
Gunfire Bullet Icon 🔴 Red Fades after 2s. Size indicates caliber/threat.
Extraction Door/Heli 🟢 Green Always visible if active.
Loot Diamond ⚪ White Only special high-tier loot marked by teammates.

📍 Tactical Map (BigMap)

Access & Layout

Accessed by tapping the Minimap. Overlays the screen (80% opacity) or slides in.

  • Orientation: ALWAYS North-Up.
    • Why? To ensure consistent “Grid Callouts” (e.g., “Enemy in B4”) regardless of individual player facing.
  • Grid System: The map is divided into A-H (Horizontal) and 1-8 (Vertical) grids.
  • Fog of War: Unexplored areas are not hidden, BUT dynamic contents (loot/enemies) are not shown unless revealed by intel. Terrain is always known.

Interactive Features

  1. Custom Waypoints:
    • Tap: Places a personal “Move” marker (White).
    • Double Tap: Places a “Danger” marker (Red).
    • Tap Teammate: Context menu (Follow / Trade).
  2. Zoom & Pan: Pinch to zoom, drag to pan.
  3. Extraction Status:
    • Extraction Zones are marked with clear icons.
    • Status: Open (Green), Closed (Red), Requires Item (Yellow Lock icon).
    • Tap an Extraction Zone to see requirements (e.g., “Needs $3000” or “No Backpack”).

Zone Info Panel

A slide-out panel on the Tactical Map showing:

  • Raid Timer: Remaining time.
  • Radiation/Gas Zone: Current spread and safe zones.
  • Active Events: E.g., “Boss detected in Hotel”.

🎯 3D World Markers (AR Pointers)

Markers that exist in the 3D game world to guide players without looking at the map.

Behavior

  • On-Screen: Floating icon clamped to the object’s position. Scales down with distance.
  • Off-Screen: If a marker is behind the player, the icon clamps to the edge of the screen pointing towards the target.
  • Distance Label: Always shows distance (e.g., “45m”) below the icon.
  • Fade: Icons turn transparent (30% opacity) when aiming down sights (ADS) or when directly over the crosshair to prevent visual obstruction.

Marker Types

  1. Objective Pointers: Main Quest / Extraction (Gold/Green).
  2. Teammate Overhead: Name + Health Bar + Equipment Icon (e.g., Class).
  3. Loot Beams:
    • Visual: Vertical light beam from the ground for high-tier loot (Legendary = Gold, Epic = Purple).
    • Only visible within short range or via perks.

📢 Ping System (Smart Comms)

A robust “Apex-style” ping system is critical for non-verbal communication.

1. Contextual Ping (Single Tap)

Pressing the Ping Button performs different actions based on what the crosshair is aiming at:

Target Object Ping Result Voice Line Icon
Terrain / Empty “Go Here” “Moving to location.” White Arrow
Enemy “Hostile” “Enemy spotted!” Red Diamond
Loot (Item) “Loot” “Level 3 Armor here.” Item Rarity Color
Open Container “Search” “Someone’s been here.” Grey Magnifier
Teammate “Group” “On me.” Blue Flag

2. Ping Wheel (Hold & Drag)

Holding the Ping Button opens a radial menu for specific commands:

  • ⬆️ Attack / Push (“Attacking!”)
  • ⬇️ Defend / Hold (“Hold this position.”)
  • ⬅️ Watching (“Watching this angle.”)
  • ➡️ Looting (“I’m looting.”)
  • ↗️ Enemy Missing (“Enemy gone?”)
  • ↖️ Group Up (“Regroup here!”)

3. Danger Ping (Double Tap)

Double-tapping the ping button immediately places a high-priority RED DANGER marker at the crosshair location with a distinct alert sound (“Enemy contact!”).

4. Intel Sharing

  • Pings from teammates appear on both the HUD (3D Marker) and the Compass/Minimap.
  • Pings last 15 seconds (Loot/Move) or 5 seconds (Enemy/Danger).

🧭 Compass Ring (Top-Down Optimized)

🚧 Implementation & Tech Constraints

Network Optimization

  • Minimap Updates: Player positions update @ 10Hz. Enemy sound markers update @ 20Hz (priority).
  • Fog of War: Calculated client-side based on server-sent visibility radius to save bandwidth.

Performance (Mobile)

  • 3D Markers: Use Screen Space UI (not World Space Canvas) where possible for batching.
  • Occlusion: Markers for loot deep within buildings should handle occlusion intelligently (e.g., show “Through Wall” icon style).

🔍 Reference Inspirations

  • Apex Legends: Contextual Ping system and Ping Wheel.
  • Arena Breakout / Lost Light: Sound visualization on Minimap (footstep waves).
  • Call of Duty Mobile: Map grid system and footprint indicators.
  • The Division: 3D AR lines floating in the world (for pathfinding integration).

item.title: Progression & Monetization
item.description:
Progression & Monetization

← Previous: User Interface | Index | Next: Weapons →

Progression Philosophy

Core Principles:

  1. Meaningful Progress - Every match advances something
  2. Multiple Paths - Cater to different playstyles
  3. Fair Free-to-Play - Never pay-to-win
  4. Respect Time - No excessive grinding
  5. Long-term Goals - Keep players engaged for months

Player Account Levels

Level System

Max Level: 100 (then Prestige)

XP Sources:

  • Match completion: 100 XP (base)
  • Successful extraction: +200 XP
  • Kills: +50 XP each
  • Assists: +25 XP each
  • Survival time: +10 XP per minute
  • Loot extracted: +1 XP per $100 value
  • Quest completion: Variable (100-1000 XP)
  • Daily login: +50 XP

XP Requirements:

Level 1→2:   1,000 XP
Level 2→3:   1,200 XP
Level 10→11: 2,500 XP
Level 25→26: 5,000 XP
Level 50→51: 10,000 XP
Level 99→100: 25,000 XP

Total to 100: ~1,500,000 XP
Estimated time: 150-200 hours

Level Rewards

Every Level:

  • Credits: 500-2,000 (scaling)
  • Cosmetic items (select levels)
  • Operator unlocks (levels 5, 10, 15)

Milestone Rewards:

Level 5:

  • Unlock Recon Operator
  • 5,000 Credits
  • Rare weapon skin

Level 10:

  • Unlock Tank Operator
  • 10,000 Credits
  • Epic gear piece

Level 15:

  • Unlock Specialist Operator
  • Rare loot container key
  • Character emote

Level 25:

  • Epic weapon skin
  • 25,000 Credits
  • Stash expansion (+10 slots)

Level 50:

  • Legendary weapon skin
  • 50,000 Credits
  • Name plate customization

Level 100:

  • Prestige option
  • Exclusive title
  • 100,000 Credits
  • Legendary operator skin

Prestige System

What is Prestige:

  • Reset to Level 1 (keep all items/operators)
  • New prestige icon
  • Exclusive cosmetics per prestige
  • Small permanent stat bonuses

Prestige Levels: 1-10

Prestige Rewards:

Prestige 1:

  • Golden name border
  • +2% XP gain (permanent)
  • Exclusive weapon skin

Prestige 5:

  • Diamond name border
  • +5% XP gain (total)
  • Legendary operator outfit

Prestige 10 (Max):

  • Rainbow name border
  • +10% XP gain (total)
  • Exclusive “Veteran” title
  • Unique emote
  • Early access to new content

Operator Progression

Individual Operator Levels

Max Level per Operator: 50

XP Gain:

  • Only when using that operator
  • Same sources as account XP
  • Independent progression

Level Milestones:

Level 5: Ability upgrade slot 1 Level 10: Cosmetic skin 1 Level 15: Stat boost (+5% health) Level 20: Ability upgrade slot 2 Level 25: Cosmetic skin 2 (rare) Level 30: Stat boost (+5% stamina) Level 35: Ability upgrade slot 3 Level 40: Cosmetic skin 3 (epic) Level 45: Stat boost (+5% sprint speed) Level 50: Prestige skin (legendary)

Operator Mastery

After Level 50:

  • Mastery points (infinite progression)
  • Mastery ranks: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Diamond
  • Purely cosmetic bragging rights
  • Operator-specific badges

Mastery Rewards:

  • Bronze (1,000 pts): Unique execution animation
  • Silver (5,000 pts): Weapon skin set
  • Gold (15,000 pts): Legendary outfit
  • Diamond (50,000 pts): Unique victory pose + title

Economy System

Currency Types

1. Credits (Soft Currency)

How to Earn:

  • Extract loot: Sell for credits
  • Level-up rewards
  • Quest completions
  • Daily login streak
  • Match performance bonuses

What to Buy:

  • Common/Uncommon weapons
  • Common armor
  • Consumables
  • Operator unlocks
  • Cosmetics (common/rare)
  • Stash expansions

Economy Balance:

  • Average match earnings: 2,000-5,000 credits
  • Good match: 8,000-15,000 credits
  • Great match: 20,000+ credits

2. Tokens (Premium Currency)

How to Obtain:

  • Purchase with real money
  • Battle Pass rewards (limited)
  • Very rare in-game drops
  • Events (limited)

What to Buy:

  • Epic/Legendary cosmetics
  • Battle Pass
  • Stash expansions (also buyable with credits)
  • Operator unlocks (shortcut)
  • XP boosters (time-based, not power)
  • Unique skins

NOT for Sale:

  • Weapons (gameplay advantage)
  • Armor (gameplay advantage)
  • Stat boosts
  • Win-rate improvements

3. Reputation (Faction Currency)

Four Factions:

  1. Salvage Corps
  2. Tech Syndicate
  3. Underground Network
  4. Peacekeepers

How to Earn:

  • Complete faction quests
  • Extract faction-specific items
  • Daily missions per faction

What to Buy:

  • Faction-exclusive cosmetics
  • Faction weapons (sidegrades, not upgrades)
  • Faction lore items
  • Special quests

Reputation Levels:

Neutral:    0 reputation
Friendly:   1,000 reputation
Honored:    5,000 reputation
Revered:    15,000 reputation
Exalted:    50,000 reputation

Faction Choice:

  • Not locked to one faction
  • Can level all simultaneously
  • Some faction quests conflict (choose wisely)

Marketplace Economy

Player-to-Player Trading: (Post-Launch Feature)

  • Trade items with other players
  • Auction house
  • Set buy/sell orders
  • Transaction fees (10% credits)

Market Pricing:

  • Dynamic pricing (supply/demand)
  • Price floors (prevent hyperinflation)
  • Anti-RMT measures (trading restrictions)

Quest System

Quest Types

1. Daily Quests (Reset: 24 hours)

Quantity: 3 quests per day

Examples:

  • “Extract $5,000 worth of loot” → Reward: 2,000 Credits, 500 XP
  • “Get 5 kills with Assault Rifles” → Reward: 1,500 Credits, 300 XP
  • “Complete 3 matches” → Reward: 1,000 Credits, 200 XP

Design Goals:

  • Quick to complete (1-3 matches)
  • Encourage daily login
  • Variety in objectives

2. Weekly Quests (Reset: 7 days)

Quantity: 5 quests per week

Examples:

  • “Extract from all 4 extraction zones” → Reward: 10,000 Credits, 2,000 XP
  • “Deal 10,000 damage” → Reward: 8,000 Credits, 1,500 XP
  • “Extract 10 rare or higher items” → Reward: Rare loot key, 2,000 XP

Design Goals:

  • More challenging
  • Require multiple sessions
  • Better rewards

3. Story Quests (One-time)

Progression:

  • Unlock lore
  • Unlock new content
  • Introduce mechanics

Example Quest Chain:

Quest 1: “First Steps”

  • Objective: Complete tutorial
  • Reward: 5,000 Credits, Basic loadout

Quest 2: “Into the Fray”

  • Objective: Extract successfully 5 times
  • Reward: 10,000 Credits, Unlock Recon operator

Quest 3: “Faction Allegiance”

  • Objective: Choose first faction, complete faction quest
  • Reward: 15,000 Credits, Faction cosmetic

Quest 10: “The Truth”

  • Objective: Find hidden lore items across all maps
  • Reward: 50,000 Credits, Legendary item, Lore unlock

4. Seasonal Quests

Duration: Entire season (2-3 months)

Objectives:

  • Long-term goals
  • Exclusive rewards
  • Seasonal cosmetics
  • Epic/Legendary items

Examples:

  • “Extract 1,000,000 Credits worth of loot”
  • “Reach Level 60”
  • “Win 100 matches”
  • “Max out one operator”

Quest Rewards Structure

Credits:

  • Daily: 1,000-2,000
  • Weekly: 5,000-15,000
  • Story: 5,000-50,000
  • Seasonal: 50,000-100,000

XP:

  • Daily: 200-500
  • Weekly: 1,000-3,000
  • Story: Variable
  • Seasonal: 10,000-50,000

Items:

  • Weapon skins
  • Operator skins
  • Loot keys
  • Consumables

Battle Pass

Structure

Tiers: 100 levels
Cost: $9.99 USD (or 1,000 Tokens)
Duration: 60-90 days per season

Two Tracks:

  • Free Track: Basic rewards (everyone)
  • Premium Track: Enhanced rewards (paid)

Progression

XP to Level:

  • Tier 1→2: 1,000 XP
  • Consistent: 1,000 XP per tier
  • Total to 100: 100,000 XP

XP Sources:

  • Same as account XP
  • Battle Pass challenges (bonus XP)
  • Weekly bonus XP (first 10 tiers faster)

Estimated Time: 60-80 hours over season

Rewards Example

Tier Free Track Premium Track
1 500 Credits 1,000 Credits
5 Weapon Skin (Common) Weapon Skin (Rare)
10 - Operator Skin (Rare)
15 1,000 Credits 2,000 Credits + 100 Tokens
25 Emote Epic Weapon Skin
50 - Epic Operator Skin
75 Rare Skin Legendary Weapon Skin
100 Epic Skin Legendary Operator Skin + 1,000 Tokens

Total Value:

  • Free Track: ~$10 USD equivalent
  • Premium Track: ~$80 USD equivalent
  • Premium also returns 1,300 Tokens (cost: 1,000)

Battle Pass Features

Challenges:

  • Daily BP challenges (bonus XP)
  • Weekly BP challenges (large XP)
  • Tier skips (can purchase with Tokens)

Catch-up Mechanisms:

  • XP boosters later in season
  • Weekend double XP events
  • Last week: Increased XP rates

Monetization Strategy

Business Model: Free-to-Play

Core Principle: NEVER Pay-to-Win

What’s Free:

  • Full game access
  • All operators (unlockable)
  • All weapons (earnable)
  • All maps
  • Ranked mode
  • Core cosmetics

What’s Paid:

  • Premium cosmetics (skins, emotes)
  • Battle Pass
  • Convenience (stash space, loadout slots)
  • Time savers (XP boosters - NOT power)

Store Structure

Featured Section

Weekly Rotation:

  • 3-5 featured items
  • Limited-time bundles
  • Discounts (10-30% off)
  • New releases

Cosmetics Shop

Operator Skins:

  • Common: 500 Credits
  • Rare: 1,000 Credits or 100 Tokens
  • Epic: 1,500 Credits or 200 Tokens
  • Legendary: Tokens only (500-1,000)

Weapon Skins:

  • Common: 300 Credits
  • Rare: 600 Credits or 75 Tokens
  • Epic: 1,200 Credits or 150 Tokens
  • Legendary: Tokens only (300-600)

Emotes:

  • Common: 200 Credits
  • Rare: 400 Credits or 50 Tokens
  • Epic: 800 Credits or 100 Tokens

Bundles:

  • Operator + matching weapon skins: 20% discount
  • Full faction theme sets: 25% discount
  • Seasonal bundles: 30% discount

Convenience Items

Stash Expansions:

  • +25 slots: 2,000 Credits or 200 Tokens
  • +50 slots: 3,500 Credits or 350 Tokens
  • Max 300 total slots

Loadout Slots:

  • +1 slot: 1,000 Credits or 100 Tokens
  • Max 10 slots

XP Boosters:

  • 1 hour: 100 Tokens
  • 1 day: 500 Tokens
  • 1 week: 2,000 Tokens
  • Effect: +50% XP (doesn’t stack)

Name Change:

  • 1,000 Credits or 100 Tokens
  • Cosmetic only

Premium Currency Pricing

Token Packages:

Package Tokens Price Bonus $/Token
Starter 500 $4.99 - $0.010
Standard 1,100 $9.99 +10% $0.009
Deluxe 2,400 $19.99 +20% $0.008
Premium 6,500 $49.99 +30% $0.008

First-Time Buyer Bonus:

  • Double tokens on first purchase
  • Exclusive “Supporter” badge

Retention Mechanics

Daily Login Rewards

7-Day Cycle:

Day Reward
1 500 Credits
2 750 Credits
3 1,000 Credits + Common Skin
4 1,500 Credits
5 2,000 Credits + Rare Skin
6 2,500 Credits
7 5,000 Credits + 100 Tokens

Monthly Cumulative:

  • 30 days: Epic Operator Skin
  • 60 days: Legendary Weapon Skin
  • 90 days: Exclusive Title + 500 Tokens

Limited-Time Events

Frequency: Every 2-4 weeks

Event Types:

1. Double XP Weekends

  • +100% XP for all matches
  • Drive weekend engagement

2. Loot Events

  • Increased rare item spawns
  • Special event-exclusive items
  • Temporary game modifiers

3. Faction Wars

  • Factions compete
  • Leaderboards
  • Winning faction gets rewards

4. Seasonal Events (Holidays)

  • Themed maps (decorations)
  • Limited cosmetics
  • Special quests
  • Event currency

Social Features

Friends System:

  • Add friends
  • See online status
  • Invite to squad
  • Gift items (future)

Clan/Guild System (Post-Launch):

  • Create/join clans
  • Clan tags
  • Clan progression
  • Clan wars (competitive)
  • Clan-exclusive rewards

Leaderboards:

  • Global rankings
  • Regional rankings
  • Friends rankings
  • Clan rankings
  • Seasonal reset

Categories:

  • Total extractions
  • Total loot value
  • Kill/Death ratio
  • Operator mastery
  • Battle Pass tier (during season)

Referral Program

Refer-a-Friend:

  • Share referral code
  • Friend must reach Level 10
  • Both get rewards:
    • 5,000 Credits
    • Rare cosmetic skin
    • 100 Tokens

Limits: Max 10 referrals per account

Seasonal Content

Season Structure

Duration: 2-3 months per season
Content:

  • New Battle Pass
  • 2 new operators (one free, one paid/unlockable)
  • New map or map update
  • Balance changes
  • New cosmetics (20-30 items)
  • Seasonal quest chain
  • Limited-time game mode

Season Roadmap (Year 1)

Season 1: “First Contact” (Launch)

  • 5 base operators
  • 2 maps
  • Battle Pass 1
  • Foundation content

Season 2: “Industrial Expansion” (Month 3)

  • 2 new operators
  • 1 new map
  • Weapon balance pass
  • Clan system

Season 3: “Urban Warfare” (Month 6)

  • 2 new operators
  • Map 2 expansion
  • New game mode: Scavenger
  • Trading system

Season 4: “Desert Storm” (Month 9)

  • 2 new operators
  • New map: Desert Outpost
  • Hardcore mode
  • Prestige expansion (to 20)

Conversion & Monetization Goals

Target Metrics

Conversion Rate: 3-5% (free to paying)
ARPU: $2-4 per month
ARPPU: $15-25 per month
LTV (6 months): $40-60

Payer Segments:

  • Minnows (57% of payers): $5-20 total
  • Dolphins (30%): $20-100 total
  • Whales (13%): $100+ total

Fair Monetization Principles

Transparency:

  • Clear pricing
  • No lootboxes (removed due to regulations)
  • No gambling mechanics
  • Exact item previews

Value:

  • Battle Pass positive value (return tokens)
  • Bundles offer discounts
  • Free path viable
  • No FOMO pressure (items return to shop)

No P2W:

  • Cosmetic-only premium items
  • No stat boosts for money
  • No exclusive powerful weapons
  • Fair matchmaking (MMR-based)

Anti-Frustration Features

No Energy System:

  • Play unlimited matches
  • No wait timers
  • No “lives” system

No Forced Ads:

  • Optional rewarded ads (watch for bonus credits)
  • Not required for progression

Reasonable Grind:

  • Earnable through play
  • Multiple progression paths
  • Catch-up mechanics for new players

Player Retention Strategy

Short-term (Days 1-7)

Goals:

  • Complete tutorial
  • Win first match
  • Extract successfully
  • Reach Level 5

Hooks:

  • Quick progression
  • Frequent rewards
  • Daily login bonus
  • Easy quests

Medium-term (Weeks 2-4)

Goals:

  • Unlock all base operators
  • Join a clan
  • Complete weekly quests
  • Reach Level 25

Hooks:

  • Operator mastery
  • Social features
  • Battle Pass progression
  • Competitive ranked

Long-term (Months 2-6)

Goals:

  • Prestige
  • Max operator mastery
  • Seasonal content
  • Competitive ranking

Hooks:

  • Seasonal updates
  • New content drops
  • Leaderboard competition

🏆 Competitive Philosophy

Core Principle: “Earn your rank through consistent performance”

Ranked mode is designed to:

  • Reward skill - Better players climb faster
  • Create fair matches - Similar skill levels play together
  • Provide progression goals - Something to strive for beyond loot
  • Foster competition - Leaderboards and seasonal rewards

NOT:

  • Pay-to-win advantages
  • Extremely grindy (should reflect skill, not hours)
  • Toxic or frustrating
  • Mandatory (casual play always available)

🎖️ Ranking System

Rank Tiers

Tier Divisions Icon Player Distribution

Silver I, II, III 🥈 ~30%
Gold I, II, III 🥇 ~20%
Platinum I, II, III 💎 ~12%
Diamond I, II, III 💠 ~5%
Master No divisions 🏆 ~2%
Champion Top 500 👑 ~1%

Rank Points (RP) System

Base RP Structure:

Starting RP: 0 (Bronze III)
Bronze → Silver: 300 RP
Silver → Gold: 600 RP
Gold → Platinum: 1000 RP
Platinum → Diamond: 1500 RP
Diamond → Master: 2000 RP
Master → Champion: Top 500 players

Division Thresholds (Example: Gold):

Gold III: 600-699 RP
Gold II: 700-799 RP
Gold I: 800-999 RP
Platinum III: 1000+ RP

RP Gains & Losses

RP Calculation Formula:

RP Change = Base RP ± Performance Modifier ± Rank Modifier

Base RP:
- Extraction: +30 RP
- Death (early): -25 RP
- Death (mid-match): -15 RP
- Death (late-match): -10 RP

Performance Modifiers:

Factor RP Modifier
Kills (per kill) +5 RP
High-value loot extracted +5 to +15 RP
Squad wipe achieved +10 RP
Top 3 finish +10 RP
Survived 10+ minutes +5 RP
Quest completion +3 RP

Rank Modifiers:

Rank Comparison Modifier
Playing against higher ranks +25% RP gains, -25% losses
Playing against same ranks Normal
Playing against lower ranks -25% RP gains, +25% losses

Protection Systems:

System Description
Demotion Shield 2 games protection when entering new tier
Streak Protection After 3 losses, reduced RP loss for next 2 games
Rank Floor Cannot drop below Bronze I once reached

🎮 Ranked Queue

Queue Requirements

To Queue Ranked:

  • Account Level 15+
  • 20+ casual matches completed
  • At least 3 operators unlocked
  • Valid phone number linked (anti-smurf)

Queue Types

Type Description Notes
Solo Individual queue Matched with other solos or partial squads
Duo 2-player team RP averaged for matching
Squad 3-4 players RP averaged, tighter matching

Rank Restrictions (Squad)

Maximum rank difference for squadding:

Your Rank Can Queue With
Bronze - Silver Any rank
Gold Silver - Platinum
Platinum Gold - Diamond
Diamond Platinum - Master
Master - Champion Diamond+ only

Unranked players treated as Bronze for queue purposes

Matchmaking Parameters

Factors (Priority Order):

  1. Rank (primary)
  2. Queue time (expands range after 2 minutes)
  3. Squad size balance
  4. Server ping

Queue Time Expansion:

0-60 seconds: ±1 division
60-120 seconds: ±2 divisions
120-180 seconds: ±1 tier
180+ seconds: ±2 tiers (warning shown)

📈 Season Structure

Season Duration

Each Season:

  • Duration: 90 days (~3 months)
  • Split into 2 Acts (45 days each)
  • Act 1 → Act 2: Soft reset
  • Season end: Hard reset

Rank Resets

Soft Reset (Mid-Season):

Champion → Diamond I
Master → Diamond II
Diamond → Platinum II
Platinum → Gold II
Gold → Gold III
Silver → Silver III
Bronze → Bronze III

Hard Reset (Season End):

All players: Rank reduced by 1.5 tiers
Placement matches: 5 games to determine starting rank
Previous season rank affects placement matches

Season Rewards

End of Season Rewards by Peak Rank:

Peak Rank Rewards
Bronze Bronze Badge, 500 Credits
Silver Silver Badge, 1,000 Credits, Common Weapon Skin
Gold Gold Badge, 2,500 Credits, Uncommon Weapon Skin
Platinum Platinum Badge, 5,000 Credits, Rare Weapon Skin, Operator Charm
Diamond Diamond Badge, 10,000 Credits, Epic Weapon Skin, Diamond Charm
Master Master Badge, 25,000 Credits, Legendary Weapon Skin, Master Trail
Champion All above + Champion Badge, Exclusive Operator Skin, Animated Banner

Rewards are:

  • Based on peak rank (highest achieved during season)
  • Distributed 3 days after season ends

🏅 Leaderboards

Leaderboard Types

Board Metric Reset

Regional RP RP by region Season
Weekly RP RP gained this week Weekly
Kill Leaders Total kills (ranked) Season
Extraction Rate % successful extracts Season

Top 500 (Champion)

Champion Tier:

  • Reserved for Top 500 players globally
  • Updated every 24 hours
  • Visible rank number (#1, #2, etc.)
  • Special champion-only rewards
  • Decay applies (must play to maintain)

Champion Decay:

  • After 48 hours of no ranked games: -50 RP/day
  • Dropping below Top 500 RP threshold: Demoted to Master
  • Playing 1 game resets decay timer

⚖️ Competitive Integrity

Anti-Cheat Measures

System Description
Kernel Anti-Cheat Required for ranked (PC)

Statistics Tracking Impossible stats reviewed

Offense Penalty

Aspect Casual Ranked

If Disconnected:

  • If reconnect: Resume at current position
  • If timeout: Treated as death (RP loss)
  • If squad extracts your body: Reduced RP loss

Map Rotation

Ranked Map Pool:

item.title: Tutorial Raid: "Operation Zero"
item.description:
Tutorial Raid: “Operation Zero”

← Back to Index | Controls →

🎓 Design Goal: “Teach to Survive”

The tutorial is NOT a shooting gallery. It is a Safety Drill. Most players quit Extraction Shooters because they loot, get lost, and die to a camper without knowing why. “Operation Zero” mimics a real raid but removes the punishment (Gear Fear).

Learning Objectives

  1. Movement & Noise: “Slow is Smooth, Smooth is Fast.”
  2. Looting Logic: Identify containers vs. trash.
  3. Healing: Fixing a “Heavy Bleed” vs. “Light Bleed”.
  4. Extraction: The panic of the timer.

🗺️ The Mission Script

Phase 1: The Crash (Movement)

  • Context: You wake up near a crashed helicopter in a dense forest (safe start).
  • Action:
    • Crawl: Under fallen debris (Force Crouch/Prone).
    • Vault: Over a broken wing.
    • Injure: Scripted fall causes a “Fracture”.
    • Heal: Use a splint found on a dead pilot. Teaches medical menu.

2. The Scavenger Camp (Stealth/Combat)

  • Context: You see 2 Scavengers looting a campfire.
  • Choice:
    • Stealth: Crouch-walk through tall grass (UI shows “Noise Meter”).
    • Loud: Shoot them. (If you miss, they yell, summoning a 3rd reinforcement).
  • Result: Loot their bodies. Find a Keycard (Quest Item).

3. The Bunker (Looting)

  • Context: Use the Keycard to open a bunker door.
  • Action:
    • Search: Find a weapon box. Teaches “Search Time”.
    • Tetris: The box contains a large Vest. You must rearrange your inventory to fit it.
    • Equip: Put on the Vest and a Helmet.

4. The Extraction (Panic)

  • Context: Alarm triggers! “Extraction Zone Active: 60 Seconds”.
  • Action: Sprint to the flare smoke.
  • Twist: An AI Sniper shoots near you (scripted miss) to induce stress. You must zigzag or slide to cover.
  • Exfil: Hold “F” at the flare. Wait 10s. Screen fades to black.

🧠 “Soft” Tutorials (Loading Screen Tips)

Don’t rely just on the raid. Use the downtime.

  • “Sound is your radar. If you can hear them, they can hear you.”
  • “Don’t peek the same angle twice.”
  • “Loot is heavy. Stamina drains faster when over 30kg.”
  • “If you find an Injector, check the description. Some kill you.”

🚫 Anti-Frustration Features

  • God Mode (Invisible): Player HP cannot drop below 1 during tutorial. (They fumble, screen turns red, but they don’t die and restart).
  • Infinite Ammo: Magazines refill instantly only in this mission.
  • Waypoint Markers: 3D UI markers guide the path (features disabled in main game).

🎁 Reward: “Starter Kit”

Completing the tutorial grants:

  1. Operator: “Rookie” (Level 1).
  2. Weapon: M4A1 (Standard) + 3 Mags.
  3. Armor: Class 2 Vest (Damaged).
  4. Currency: $5,000 (Enough for 1 raid insurance).

This gear is yours. If you lose it in the next raid, it’s gone forever. Welcome to Aethelgard.

User Settings & Configuration

⚙️ Design Philosophy

“Power to the Player, Simplicity for the Casual.” Settings should offer granular control for competitive players while providing simple, intelligent presets for casual users. All settings must be saved to the cloud and synced across devices.

🎮 1. Control Settings (Input)

General Input

Setting Type Default Description
Sensitivity Slider (0.1 - 5.0) 1.0 Global mouse/touch sensitivity.
ADS Sensitivity Slider (0.1 - 2.0) 0.8 Sensitivity multiplier when Aiming Down Sights.
Scope Sensitivity Slider (0.1 - 2.0) 0.6 Multiplier for high-zoom scopes (>4x).
Invert Look Toggle OFF Invert Y-axis.
Vibration Toggle ON Haptic feedback for shooting/damage.

Movement & Combat (Advanced)

Setting Option Default Description
Crouch Mode Hold / Toggle Toggle “Hold” requires keeping the key pressed. “Toggle” switches state on press.
Prone Mode Hold / Toggle Toggle Separate keybind available. Same logic as Crouch.
Sprint Mode Hold / Toggle Toggle “Hold” stops sprinting on release. “Toggle” keeps sprinting until stop.
Tactical Sprint Single Tap / Double Tap Double Tap Engage super-sprint (weapon up, slower fire time).
Walk Mode Hold / Toggle Hold Silent movement modifier. Reduces noise by 60%.
Lean Mode Hold / Toggle / Auto Hold Peek around corners. “Auto” leans when near edge and aiming.
Auto-Lean ON / OFF OFF Automatically lean when aiming near a corner.
Aim Mode Hold / Toggle Hold Aiming Down Sights (ADS) behavior.
ADS Transition Smooth / Instant Smooth “Smooth” blends animation (realistic). “Instant” snaps view (competitive).
Auto-Sprint OFF / Normal / Tactical OFF Automatically sprint when moving forward without holding Shift.
Quick Throw ON / OFF ON Grenade throws immediately on key press. OFF = Hold to aim arc.
Bolt Action Mode Release / Manual Release “Release” cycles bolt on key release. “Manual” requires extra click.

Controller / Mobile Specific

Setting Option Default Description
Gyro Aiming OFF / Scope / Always Scope Use device tilt for fine adjustments.
Gyro Sensitivity Slider (1-300%) 100% Separate X/Y axis sliders.
Aim Assist Standard / Precision / Focusing Standard “Standard” slows near target. “Precision” slows only on hitbox.
Aim Response Curve Standard / Linear / Dynamic Standard Input curve mapping.
Stick Deadzone Slider (0.00 - 0.50) 0.10 Min input to register movement (fixes drift).
Automations Auto-Loot / Auto-Open Doors ON Mobile QoL features.

Key Bindings & Input Mapping (PC Default)

System: Supports Primary and Secondary bindings for all actions.

Movement

Action Primary Secondary Context
Move Forward W

Move Right D

Lean Right E

Combat

Aim Down Sights R-Click

Communication & UI

🖥️ 2. Graphics Settings (Visuals)

Display

  • Window Mode: Fullscreen / Borderless / Windowed.
  • NVIDIA Reflex: OFF / ON / ON+BOOST (Reduces input latency).
  • V-Sync: OFF (Competitive) / ON.
  • Frame Rate Limit: Lobby (60), Game (Unlocked/144/240).

Upscaling & Sharpening

Setting Options Description
Upscaling DLSS / FSR / XeSS / OFF Resolution scaling for FPS.
Quality Mode Performance / Balanced / Quality
Sharpening Slider (0 - 100)

Detailed Quality

Setting Level (Low-Ultra) Cost Description
Texture Quality Low - Ultra VRAM Surface detail.
Texture Filtering Bilinear - Anisotropic 16x GPU Texture clarity at angles.
LOD Quality 1.0 - 2.5 CPU Distance objects degrade to low-poly. Critical for spotting enemies.
Shadow Quality Low - Ultra GPU “Low” removes dynamic shadows on small props.

Post-Processing (Visibility)

Setting Option Description
Motion Blur OFF / ON Always OFF for competitive.
Depth of Field OFF / ON Blurs weapon/background when aiming. OFF recommended.
Film Grain Slider (0.0 - 1.0) Visual noise. Set to 0.0.
Chromatic Aberration OFF / ON Color fringing at screen edges. OFF for clarity.

Voice Chat (VoIP)

  • Mode: Push-to-Talk / Open Mic / Mute.

  • Output Device: Select headset/speakers.

💾 5. Account & Privacy

  • Streamer Mode: Hides your name (“Player123”) and server IP. Delays matchmaking status.
  • Crossplay: ON / OFF (Console only).
